Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
What exactly happens when a Nosferatu Antitribu gains a Writ of Acceptance?

exclusive concepts.

now a regular Nosferatu, or is he clanless?

Messages.Author: David Schwartz
Messages.Body:
Judas Iscariot writes:
>> Writ of Acceptance?
>related to this: where is the Sabbat version of this card so that
>vampires can become members of the Sabbat? This seems to be a MAJOR
>oversight be the designers!!

The Camarilla has a very open policy. They let any individual or
clan who asks nicely and swears to the Traditions into their
sect. They accept the clanless into their fold. That's why there
are many ways to join the Camarilla.

The Sabbat, one the other hand, take the applicant (some would
say supplicant) to a graveyard. Then they hit him over the head
with a shovel (no other implement will do) and bury him six
feet down. Then they have a party, until the initiate digs
himself out. At this point the vampire is ravenously hungry
and he goes on a feeding frenzy. When he calms down, they do
the Vaulderi -- all the pack members drip some of their own
blood into a chalice, and everybody drinks from it. This is
their idea of loyalty building exercise.

If you really must simulate this precedure, just use Clan
Impersonation and make yourself an Antitribu of your clan.
The two blood cost should cover the whole gamut. Of course,
if you're an independent, you'll have to wait for the Black
Hand expansion, unless you're Giovani. There are no Giovana
Antitribu.
